### Changed

- Change where a new or restored entry goes in a manually ordered collection (`order: 'manual'`): it is now first in the Studio list and on the website, not last, so editors no longer move it up one place at a time. Entries brought in by import, seed or a release keep the order they bring; auto-sorted collections and navigation trees do not change. ([#90](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/90))
